title: Seamless and informative....
text: Seamless and informative. Your guide was knowledgeable. Very easy to use Viator for excursions. I would use again.
author: Harriett_S

title: Lots of Informations...
text: Lots of Informations about La Sagrada Familia. The guide was very good. The tour was about 2 hours. Very interesting .

title: Beyond beauty
text: The colors, the feel and the architecture.  The smallest of details waiting to be seen.  Beyond words to describe its beauty.
author: Valerie B

title: Our guide presented the Basilica and historical information in a very good way, short and entertaining
text: Length and time of walk was adequate, quality of sound system was good, only sometimes I was not sure where the guide was pointing at
author: Joerg H
